operations.description: Read the signed-in user, storage quota and Drive capabilities; Drive requires fields for this method, such as user,storageQuota

List files matching the search query q, one page per call; the walk follows nextPageToken as pageToken and ends on a page without it; that end condition holds only if fields, when given, includes nextPageToken, so include it (for example nextPageToken,files(id,name))
Read one file's metadata by fileId; its content is not downloaded here (use files.export for Google Workspace documents)
Export one Google Workspace document to the text mimeType given, such as text/plain, returned as text; at most the engine's 4 MiB response limit
Read the start page token: the baseline from which changes.list reports later changes

List changes since pageToken, one page per call; the walk follows nextPageToken and ends on the page carrying newStartPageToken, the next baseline; that end condition holds only if fields, when given, includes nextPageToken and newStartPageToken, so include both (for example nextPageToken,newStartPageToken,changes)
Create a file from metadata only, such as a Google Workspace document, a folder (mimeType application/vnd.google-apps.folder) or a shortcut; no content is uploaded
Change one file's metadata while its version is the pinned version; fields selects both the preflight read and the answer and must include version
Copy one file; the body names the copy and its parents
